items.title: Charles Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997
items.q: I’m on an occasion now to travel next week to Austria with Rodney Kendricks.

ctx.x: So you travel outside of the country on occasion?
Yes, on quite a few occasions. I’m on an occasion now to travel next week to Austria with Rodney Kendricks.
Is the reaction to jazz music any different overseas than here?
